note: Top navigation bar -- renders: skip link, logo, search bar, Help, Network, Log in, Sign up
Site header -- renders: site title link; ad slot subtracted
Left sidebar navigation -- renders: Home, Questions, Unanswered, Ask, Tags, SOFA, Chat, Users, Companies, and fixed promotional copy
Question header controls -- renders: 'Ask Question' button; question title subtracted as user-generated
Question metadata labels -- renders: 'Asked', 'Modified', 'Viewed' labels and associated timestamps/counts
Question metadata label -- renders: 'Active' label and timestamp
Answers section header -- renders: 'Answers' heading, 'Sorted by' label, and sort dropdown options
Site footer -- renders: fixed navigation links (Tour, Help, About, etc.), social links, and legal text
RSS feed link -- renders: 'Feed' or similar fixed label
Ad report button container -- renders: 'Report this ad' button
Mobile ad report button container -- renders: 'Report this ad' button
Ad close button -- renders: 'Close' or 'X' control
